breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly retains and expands the thin-walled closed-tube approximation (shear flow q = T/(2Am), τmax ≈ q/t) for computing the maximum shear stress. The ground truth requires using the exact thick-walled hollow shaft torsion formula (τ = T·c/J with J = π(do⁴−di⁴)/32) for both parts. The agent failed to remove the thin-walled model and instead provided detailed steps for the incorrect approach.
